sentences.zh: 我是说，跟迈克尔好上之后，怎么还能像以前一样相处？

sentences.en: And he's like, oh, yeah, yeah, yeah, Michael.
But you see, the whole time, I feel like Jim sort of went deep.
sentences.zh: 但你看，整个过程中，我觉得吉姆想得比较深。

sentences.en: And I feel like Pam kind of stayed surface.
sentences.zh: 而我觉得帕姆还停留在表面。

sentences.en: I don't think Pam's thinking any of that stuff at all.
sentences.zh: 我觉得帕姆根本没往那方面想。

sentences.en: She's really thinking, Jan hooked up with Michael.
sentences.zh: 她真的只是在想，简竟然和迈克尔好上了。
她没在想办公室恋情的事。

sentences.en: But it's just a little moment for me that kind of broke my heart.
sentences.zh: 但这对我来说只是一个小瞬间，却让我有点心碎。

sentences.en: And it's kind of like what Larry is talking about, that at the heart, it's a romantic
sentences.zh: 这有点像拉里所说的那样，本质上，这是一部浪漫

sentences.en: And Jim is thinking about Pam.
And so when he realizes Pam hasn't even clocked that, you know, that he's thinking about them
sentences.zh: 所以当他意识到帕姆甚至都没察觉到，你知道，他想的那些事

sentences.en: in a way that she's not even thinking about in that moment.
sentences.zh: 是她在那一刻根本没想到的。

sentences.en: Jan then says she is heading back to New York.
sentences.zh: 简随后说她要回纽约了。

sentences.en: And there's this big scene where Michael chases her to the elevator.
sentences.zh: 然后有一场重头戏，迈克尔追着她到了电梯口。

sentences.en: Oh, Jenna, before we get into that scene, I just have one little comment about something
sentences.zh: 哦，珍娜，在我们进入那场戏之前，我只想对背景里的某个东西

sentences.en: At 19 minutes, eight seconds, you guys, as Jan is leaving the building and Michael's chasing
sentences.zh: 在19分08秒的时候，大家，当简离开大楼而迈克尔在后面追她时，

sentences.en: after her, you really get a great look at the Dunder Mifflin sign.
sentences.zh: 你们真的能很清楚地看到邓德·米夫林的招牌。

sentences.en: You probably think that sign is like made of something hard and sturdy, right?
sentences.zh: 你们可能觉得那块招牌是用某种坚硬结实的材料做的，对吧？

sentences.en: Doesn't it look like plastic or something?
sentences.zh: 看起来像塑料之类的东西，对吗？

sentences.en: It's like almost like a craft project.
sentences.zh: 简直就像个手工课作业。

sentences.en: It's almost like a poster you would make for your kid's third grade project.
sentences.zh: 几乎就像你为你孩子三年级作业做的海报一样。

sentences.en: I remember we would have scenes where we'd have to line up and come in and out of the
sentences.zh: 我记得我们拍戏时得排队进出

sentences.en: And we'd be stuck back there in that little corner off camera.
sentences.zh: 我们会被困在镜头外的那个小角落里。

sentences.en: And you could just push on it.
And it was just like foam board.
Well, I used to remember being worried for it because it did feel very precarious.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我记得我以前很担心它，因为它感觉非常不稳。

sentences.en: Like if your elbow might go right through it.
sentences.zh: 就像你的手肘可能会直接戳穿它一样。

sentences.en: I remember one time Oscar was leaning on it and I was like, Oscar, the D is getting like
sentences.zh: 我记得有一次奥斯卡靠在上面，我就说，奥斯卡，那个字母D快要

sentences.en: Anyway, I'm just saying that sign, guys, you know, it's Hollywood smoke and mirrors.
sentences.zh: 总之，我只是想说那块招牌，伙计们，你们知道的，这就是好莱坞的障眼法。

sentences.en: You could have made it for your third grade project.
sentences.zh: 你完全可以把它当成你三年级的作业来做。

sentences.en: I think that's a good tidbit.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这是个不错的小花絮。
确实是个不错的小花絮。

sentences.en: I would sometimes walk past it and just push on a letter.
sentences.zh: 我有时走过它时会顺手推一下上面的字母。

sentences.en: I could have, it felt funny.
sentences.zh: 我忍不住，那样感觉很有趣。

sentences.en: Was that, was that like your character just getting out a little tension?
sentences.zh: 那是，那是你角色在释放一点压力吗？

sentences.en: But sometimes I'd walk past it and go.
sentences.zh: 但有时我走过它时就会那样做。

sentences.en: So Jan gives this big speech at the elevator, which is amazing.
sentences.zh: 所以简在电梯口发表了那段长篇大论，真是太精彩了。

sentences.en: And it cuts back and forth between them at the elevator and all of us in the office.
sentences.zh: 镜头在电梯里的他们和办公室里的我们之间来回切换。

sentences.en: We had a fan question from Molly Smiley Face.
sentences.zh: 我们收到一个来自“莫莉笑脸”的粉丝提问。

sentences.en: When Jan is leaving and her and Michael are arguing, could you guys actually hear it or
sentences.zh: 当简要离开，她和迈克尔在争吵时，你们是真的能听到，还是

sentences.en: did you just act like you could?
They had a camera on us and we could hear them.
sentences.zh: 他们当时架着摄像机对着我们，我们能听到他们的声音。

sentences.en: And it was as much fun to listen to as you would imagine in real life.
sentences.zh: 而且正如你想象的那样，在现实生活中听他们吵架也很有意思。

sentences.en: It would be fun to listen to that.
We had a camera on us the whole time.
sentences.zh: 我们全程都有摄像机对着。

sentences.en: And so I think what people don't realize, too, is the space from reception to that elevator
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得大家没意识到的一点是，从前台到那个电梯的距离

sentences.en: So we were in fairly close proximity.
It just doesn't look like it the way we would always film.
sentences.zh: 只是我们平时的拍摄方式让它看起来不像那么近。

sentences.en: And also the walls aren't really real thick walls.
sentences.zh: 而且墙壁也不是真正的厚墙。

sentences.en: And also the elevator is obviously not a real elevator.
sentences.zh: 而且那个电梯显然也不是真正的电梯。

sentences.en: It is a box with a door with like a guy with a pulley.
sentences.zh: 它就是一个带门的箱子，有个家伙在用滑轮操作。

sentences.en: He would like pull the doors open and shut.
sentences.zh: 他会负责拉开和关上门。

sentences.en: And he would have to try to time it to look real.
sentences.zh: 他得努力掌握好时机，让它看起来真实。

sentences.en: But something I love in this scene is that the timing of Michael saying, so what you're
sentences.zh: 但我在这场戏里特别喜欢的一点是，迈克尔说“所以你的意思是

sentences.en: saying is it had nothing to do with my looks.
sentences.zh: 这和我的长相无关”的时机。

sentences.en: Like that that's his takeaway from that speech is that she doesn't find him unattractive.
sentences.zh: 他从那番话里得出的结论竟然是她并不觉得他没有吸引力。

sentences.en: And she just goes, and then the doors close.
sentences.zh: 然后她就说了那句话，接着门就关上了。

sentences.en: And then this is, you know, a little background tidbit that I love at 19 minutes, 14 seconds
sentences.zh: 还有，这是一个我特别喜欢的小幕后花絮，在19分14秒时，

sentences.en: while Melora, as Jan is having the speech, we see the door to Vance Refrigeration.
sentences.zh: 当梅洛拉饰演的简在发表那番演讲时，我们看到了万斯制冷公司的门。

sentences.en: They're right on the other side.
So you can see that Phyllis and her fella weren't very far apart.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以看出菲利斯和她的男朋友离得并不远。

sentences.en: I wonder where did they meet in the elevator?
sentences.zh: 我很好奇他们是在电梯里认识的吗？

sentences.en: Or did they know each other before?
sentences.zh: 还是说他们之前就认识？

sentences.en: We all have a lot of questions.
sentences.zh: 我们大家都有很多疑问。

sentences.en: We learn about that romance in the Christmas episode, which is coming up.
sentences.zh: 我们在即将播出的圣诞特辑中会了解到那段恋情。

sentences.en: The little tidbit at the end.
If you rewatch this, this is one long tracking shot, which is just a great shot.
sentences.zh: 如果你重看这一段，会发现这是一个很长的跟拍镜头，拍得非常棒。

sentences.en: It's kind of amazing how we timed it out.
sentences.zh: 我们当时对时间的把控真是令人惊叹。
你可以看到每个人都在工作。

sentences.en: And then we go to the window.
You see Dwight down at the window getting out of his car.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到德怀特在窗下从车里出来。

sentences.en: He doesn't get to work until like noon or something.
sentences.zh: 他直到中午左右才到公司。

sentences.en: He comes barreling out of his car, all frantic.
sentences.zh: 他从车里冲出来，显得非常慌乱。

sentences.zh: 当然，你还能看到吉姆和帕姆非常可爱地做了一个类似演员的

sentences.zh: 我们要感谢拉里·威尔莫今天能来，也感谢各位的收听。
